integrity: The universal allocation formula is proved by a two-by-two characteristic polynomial and strictly convex scalar trace. The example uses an independently checkable exact matrix exponential and rational crossing certificate. Finite numerical tests are supplemental and do not stand in for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The dose cost is additive log-survival, not empirically calibrated treatment expenditure.
The exact algebraic budget threshold uses a constructed two-stage, density-independent population model.
At the neutral Floquet multiplier the ecological fate is not classified.
Mutation, fitness cost, nonlinear crowding, and finite population stochastic extinction are not studied.
Earlier matrix-scaling and log-convexity results may contain related special cases; priority is not independently established.
title: An exact log-kill budget separating extinction from growth in a resistant two-stage population
